_note: svelte-check --tsgo runs svelte2tsx with emitOnTemplateError: false, so a component the compiler's parse() rejects makes svelte2tsx throw and the file is dropped: no overlay (so its broken TypeScript cannot hide type errors elsewhere), no diagnostics of any source, not counted in FILES. Covered: a template expression that is not valid JS (`{a +}`) and a non-boolean <svelte:options runes> value (`runes={x}`, `runes="true"`). Only Ok.svelte reports. Verified against svelte-check 4.4.6.
